text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Casio PV-2000 was an 8-bit home computer and gaming system released in Japan in 1983. Unlike the PV-1000 console, the PV-2000 was designed as a computer system with built-in BASIC programming capabilities and cartridge support. It shared hardware similarities with Casio's gaming products while targeting home users interested in both programming and entertainment. The system had a limited release and software library, making it a rare example of Casio's early attempts to enter the home computer market.
